title: Printed polygon card sort
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Shape; position and direction; decimals
source: Seeded from mathematics/y5 lesson 67 (Printed polygon card sort)
intro: Lesson 67: Regular and irregular polygons. To understand the difference between regular and irregular polygons

blocks.title: Sort into: Regular / Irregular
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Regular, Irregular.
blocks.answer: Regular: Square; Equilateral triangle; Regular hexagon. Irregular: Rectangle; Rhombus; Right-angled triangle

questions.model: Teacher: 3 equal sides and 3 equal angles (60° each): regular.

questions.q: A shape has 8 equal sides but different angles. Regular?
Name and say regular or irregular: 5 equal sides and angles; 4 sides, angles 90° and sides 3, 5, 3, 5 cm
questions.model: Teacher: 5 equal sides and angles: regular pentagon.

questions.q: Draw an irregular hexagon on squared paper.
Why do bees use regular hexagons? Give one reason.
questions.a: They fit together with no gaps

questions.q: Regular means... A) equal sides and equal angles B) equal sides only C) 4 sides
questions.a: A) equal sides and equal angles

questions.q: Big question: what makes a shape regular?
questions.a: All its sides and all its angles are equal
